parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paging query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: FirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.
> FirewallId is required. If it is not specified, ErrorParameters(400) is returned. TrFirewallRoutePolicyId must be used together with FirewallId. If TrFirewallRoutePolicyId is specified without FirewallId, ErrorParameters(400) is returned. If the value is invalid or does not exist, ErrorTrFirewallPolicyNotFound is returned.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: TrFirewallRoutePolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the firewall routing policy.
